description: This file defines a Java Servlet class 'DeleteCategory' that handles HTTP GET requests to delete a category based on a 'CID' parameter. It interacts with the database utility 'CategoryDBUtil' to perform the deletion and redirects or forwards the response accordingly.

classes.name: DeleteCategory
classes.description: A Java Servlet class that handles the deletion of categories in an online grocery ordering system by intercepting HTTP GET requests.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests, retrieves the 'CID' parameter from the request, invokes the deleteCategory method, and redirects or forwards based on success.
